name: web-scumm

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run test:assets && npm run build:game
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --exclude tests/ownership.test.ts --exclude tests/audit.test.ts --exclude tests/canonical.test.ts --exclude tests/memo.test.ts --exclude tests/reference-proof.test.ts
scripts.test:node: vitest run --exclude tests/pixel.test.ts --exclude tests/studio-assets.test.ts --exclude tests/ownership.test.ts --exclude tests/audit.test.ts --exclude tests/canonical.test.ts --exclude tests/memo.test.ts --exclude tests/reference-proof.test.ts
scripts.check: tsx tools/select-game.ts && tsc --noEmit && npm run test:node
scripts.verify:game: npm run validate && npm run solve && npm run solve -- --chapters && npm run i18n -- status && npm run lint && npm run playtests
scripts.prove:game: npm run solve -- --prove && npm run solve -- --prove --chapters && npm run solve:reality
scripts.release-check: npm run doctor && npm run quality && npm run build && npm run test:coverage && npm run verify:release && npm run prove:game && npm run solve -- --audit-abstractions && npm run reality:xcheck -- --require-rust && npm run test:mutation:core && npm run audit:deps && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint:code && knip --no-progress && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.strictest.json && npm run lint:content
scripts.assets: mkdir -p .cache && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json tools/refs.ts > .cache/refs.json && python3 tools/assets.py
scripts.build:studio-demo: tsx tools/select-game.ts && STUDIO=1 VITE_STUDIO_DEMO=1 vite build
scripts.verify:release: npm run validate -- --release && npm run weight -- --release && npm run i18n -- status && npm run voices -- check --release && npm run playtests -- --strict
scripts.verify:commercial: npm run verify:release && npm run validate -- --commercial --errors && npm run verify:dist
scripts.verify:field: npm run verify:commercial && npm run playtests -- --strict --require=5 --require-completed=3 --require-devices=2
scripts.test:heavy: vitest run tests/ownership.test.ts tests/audit.test.ts tests/canonical.test.ts tests/memo.test.ts tests/reference-proof.test.ts
scripts.build:game: npm run verify:game && vite build && npm run verify:dist && npm run check:spoilers && npm run audit:assets

description: Mobile-first SCUMM-style point-and-click engine with authoring tools and an AI-friendly workflow
